title: Kaun sambhale
body:
girte huwe naaqe se zameen par
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi baradar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
<<DIVIDER>>
athara bhai ki behen pe
kaisi musibat aayi hai
haath bandhe hai pusht ke bal
aur gard badan par chaayi hai
sar pe nahi hai maqna o chadar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
aun o mohamed qasim aur
abbas e dilawar koi nahi
kaun madad ko aayega aakhir
monis o yawar koi nahi
abid hai par wo bhi hai laaghar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
koi agar girta hai to wo
haathon ka sahara leta hai
lekin zainab ke girne ka
haal bahot ranjeeda hai
chehre ke bal girti hai muztar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sab ko bachaya khud ko faqat
takleef mein dhaala zainab ne
karbobala se shaam talak
har ek ko sambhala zainab ne
lekin ab hai shaam ka manzar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab ye chali thi apne watan se
saani e hyder saath mein thay
inki amaari sab se haseen thi
saare baradar saath mein thay
ab hai magar tanha ye yahan par
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh rahi hain uski nigahein
bheed mein apna koi nahi
shaam ke logon ka majma hai
ahle madina koi nahi
chaaron taraf hai zulm ka lashkar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
shaam ke zaalim maar rahe thay
zainab ko jab patthar se
dekh ke nok e naiza par
abbas e dilawar ke sar se
kehne lagi fizza ro ro kar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
na-mahram hai log sabhi
aur ghairon ki aabadi hai
shaam ke bazaron mein khule sar
kufe ki shehzadi hai
dukhiya par haste hai sitamgar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
<<DIVIDER>>
dekh ke zainab ko is gham mein
sab ko khayaal aaya hoga
dil mein kumail o aamir ye
logon ke sawaal aaya hoga
nok e sina par sar hai bahattar
kaun sambhale zainab ko
saath nahi hai koi...
author: Kumail Jafri
